rules: No Inter or generic sans for headings. Rotate font arsenal.
Headings must use tight letter spacing: tracking-tight or tracking-tighter.
Overlines/labels MUST be Uppercase + Tiny + Wide Spacing (tracking-[0.2em]).
Max heading size text-5xl on desktop. Use fluid scaling.

contrast_rules: ALWAYS explicitly set text color on hover - never rely on inheritance.
DO NOT use complete transparent background in header, overlays, any surface that has content under it.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Flat Solid surfaces instead of Glass to prevent visual refraction of data. Health/Research apps require optical clarity.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px delicate inner stroke or subtle solid borders to define grid edges. Use 'Grid Borders' style for data-heavy sections.
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle grain overlays to kill digital flatness.

grids_and_layouts.dashboard_grid: High Density Grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 with gap-4 or gap-6.
grids_and_layouts.spacing: Generous Spacing Philosophy. Use p-6 or p-8 inside cards. 2-3x more spacing than default.
grids_and_layouts.alignment: Optical alignment over geometrical. Left-align dense content.

components.navigation: Visible sidebar or top nav with solid background. Include Dark/Light theme toggle.
components.cards: Flat background, 1px subtle border, no shadow by default. Hover: slight lift and shadow.
components.forms_and_inputs: Use Shadcn components but strip the default Vercel look via Tailwind. Customize spacing and radii.
components.tables: Dense, highly legible, left-aligned data. Use JetBrains Mono for numbers and IDs.

rules: Staggered entrance animations for lists (e.g., live run agent steps).
NO universal transitions (transition: all). Use specific transitions (e.g. transition-colors, transition-transform).
Add data-testid to ALL interactive and key informational elements.

image_urls.description: Interconnected nerve cells with nodes. Use for AI Master Orchestrator backgrounds or network graph empty states.
Scientist in lab coat using a laptop. Use for the dashboard welcome section, onboarding, or team page.

3d_libraries.recommendation: Recharts for general stats, D3.js (if heavy data)
3d_libraries.usage: Use Recharts (via Shadcn) for Dashboard with stats and Insights library. Use standard React state for the live run view.

instructions_to_main_agent: CRITICAL: The environment uses .js and .jsx files. Write .js/.jsx, NOT .tsx files.
Install fonts: Cabinet Grotesk (headings), IBM Plex Sans (body), JetBrains Mono (data/code).
Install @phosphor-icons/react for icons. Do NOT use emojis for icons.
Implement a dark/light theme toggle, default to dark.
Master Orchestrator Live Run View: Build a staggered list layout showing agent steps (Scout, Analyst, Critic, etc.). Use Mono font for audit logs and agent outputs.
Agent Registry Page: Use a high-density bento grid.
Insights Library: Create a dense card list or table with explicitly highlighted novelty/confidence scores and citations.
Audit Trail Log Table: Use 'Grid Borders' style (border-collapse, border-r border-b on cells).
Do NOT use Space Grotesk. Do NOT use Teal Green (#1B93A4) or Purple (#7351B7).
Ensure ALL interactive elements have kebab-case data-testid attributes based on role.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use Flat Solid backgrounds instead of glassmorphism for medical data clarity.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons. Use the specified icon library.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Main agent relies on these image URLs. Missing categories = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Use sonner for toasts, located in /app/frontend/src/components/ui/sonner.js (or .jsx).
